notes: Lumen "Plasma Forge" (neon, 4x3, manned): the smelter frame in navy panels with 1px cyan edges. A glass bottle holds a magenta arc that spins round a crystal electrode (two bright arc heads chase round the ring, 4 frames); tuning-fork resonators either side hum (their tines spread and close: it sings); a crystal hopper top-left feeds silicon shards in; the console screen draws the song as a cyan wave; a capacitor bank with magenta charge lamps on the right; the line along the bottom carries new glass lattice (white-magenta hot, then cyan, then set). Damaged: the bottle is cracked and the arc leaks out through it in a stray tendril, one resonator is bent and silent, the wave is jagged. Disabled: the bottle shattered and dark, the electrode dull, every edge line dead, shards in the line.
